about: Winter windows for roads OSM leaves open: read by pipeline/winter_closures.py. Each window is (start month, start day, end month, end day), both ends closed. docs/winter-closures-national.md has the rules for choosing them.

roads.road: Beartooth Highway (US 212), Montana, north of the state line
roads.basis: "Typically open the Friday of Memorial Day weekend to mid-October" (closed Oct 12 in 2026). The Friday falls on May 28 at the latest, so closed through May 27. MDT closes US 212 mileposts 45-56

as the Montana part; WYDOT closes US 212 from WY 296 to Beartooth Pass, and from Cooke City to Pilot Creek 9 miles are closed to wheeled vehicles. Pilot Creek's position is not published, so the whole of US 212 from WY 296 to Cooke City is closed, the longer reading

roads.road: Beartooth Highway (US 212), Montana, east of Cooke City
roads.basis: as the Wyoming part; the plowed road ends at the east edge of Cooke City

roads.road: Grand Loop Road, Canyon Village to Tower Fall (Dunraven Pass), Yellowstone
roads.basis: 2026 schedule: closes Oct 12, opens May 22. The rest of the park's roads take its own row

roads.road: Sonora Pass (CA 108), Strawberry Sno-Park to US 395
roads.basis: last ten seasons as Caltrans reported them: opened Jun 13 (2017) and Jun 9 (2023) at the latest; gates closed ahead of storms as early as Nov 1. dot.ca.gov refused connections from the build machine on 2026-10-18 (a bogus URL failed the same way), so these were read as Caltrans' releases quoted in search results and the local press

roads.road: Ebbetts Pass (CA 4), Lake Alpine to the Raymond Meadows gate
roads.basis: last ten seasons: opened Jun 30 (2017, the latest in the road's history) at the latest, Jun 8 in 2023, May 6 in 2026. No closing record was found; Caltrans closes it with Sonora Pass at the first big storm, so Sonora's Nov 1. dot.ca.gov was unreachable, as for Sonora Pass

roads.road: Mount Blue Sky Road (CO 5), Echo Lake to the summit
roads.basis: "Summit open Memorial Day through Labor Day only". Closed from the day after Labor Day, Sep 2 at the earliest, to the Friday of Memorial Day weekend, May 28 at the latest. Echo Lake to Summit Lake stays open to about Sep 30, but the page gives that section no dates, so it takes the summit's

roads.road: Independence Pass (CO 82), Aspen to Twin Lakes gates
roads.basis: closing dates 2015-2025, the earliest Oct 25 (2021); "CDOT typically reopens the pass the week prior to the Memorial Day holiday weekend", read as late as May 27

roads.road: North Cascades Highway (WA 20), Ross Dam Trailhead (MP 134) to the Silver Star gate (MP 171)
roads.basis: WSDOT's table, 2016-2025: earliest closing Nov 3 (2022), latest opening May 16 (2017). 2026's full reopening on Jun 19 was storm-damage repair, not snow. The east end is the Silver Star Gate, which OSM also tags `access:conditional=no @ winter`. The last waypoint carries the path 30 m past the Silver Star Gate, onto the one edge of Highway 20 an NPS `USFS SEASONAL=Yes` segment marks, so this window replaces the unknown season (Oct 1 - Jun 30) there (docs/seasonal-road-policy.md, fix 1)

roads.road: Chinook Pass (WA 410), Crystal Mountain Boulevard to Morse Creek
roads.basis: WSDOT's table, 2016-2025: earliest closing Oct 24 (2025), latest opening Jun 11 (2018)

roads.road: Kuwohi Road (formerly Clingmans Dome Road), Great Smoky Mountains
Mt. Washington Auto Road, base to summit
roads.basis: 2026 drive-yourself calendar: weekends only Apr 25 - May 22, daily May 23 - Nov 1, and Oct 19 - Nov 1 marked late season to a lower cutoff. Read at the longer ends: closed Oct 19 to May 22, since a weekday or a summit drive is closed in both. OSM's seasonal=no_snow keeps it closed Nov 1 - Apr 30 besides. The second and third waypoints sit one on each half of the one-way pair near the base, so the path covers both directions (docs/seasonal-road-policy.md, "The default gives way")

roads.road: Crater Lake: the North Entrance Road and West Rim Drive, from the park's north boundary to Rim Village
roads.basis: the park's opening and closing dates for the North Entrance and West Rim Drive, as tools/seasonal_risk/q2_published_dates.csv records them. Last ten seasons with an opening, 2014-2023: latest Jun 30 (2023), so closed through Jun 29. Last ten with a closing, 2012-2021: earliest Oct 14 (2016). Split from the park's one window, which held this half to Jul 31 (docs/seasonal-road-policy.md, fix 2)

roads.road: Crater Lake: East Rim Drive, from the park headquarters junction clockwise round the east rim to North Junction
roads.basis: the park's opening and closing dates for East Rim Drive, as tools/seasonal_risk/q2_published_dates.csv records them. Last ten seasons with an opening, 2013-2022: latest Jul 21 (2017), so closed through Jul 20. Closings: the ten latest seasonal ones, 2011-2012 and 2014-2021, earliest Oct 13 (2017). 2013's Oct 1 is left out: it is the first day of the federal government shutdown, when every national park closed, not a closing for the season (with it the window would open Oct 1). docs/seasonal-road-policy.md, fix 2

roads.road: Going-to-the-Sun Road over Logan Pass, Avalanche Creek to Rising Sun
roads.basis: NPS's Logan Pass record, last ten seasons 2013-2022 (2023 is blank). Latest opening Jul 13 (2020 and 2022), so closed through Jul 12; 2020's was delayed by the pandemic, and 2022's, by avalanches, sets the same date. Closings: the ones NPS footnotes as something other than the season are left out, as not seasonal: 2014 (Sep 22), 2015 (Oct 5) and 2022 (Oct 16), road rehabilitation; 2017 (Sep 3), the Sprague Fire and road construction; 2013 (Sep 23), the government shutdown. The earliest of the rest (2016 and 2018-2021) is Sep 25 (2019). Replaces OSM's `Oct-Jun` with the record on the edges it covers, since its window holds that one (docs/seasonal-road-policy.md, fix 3)

parks.basis: 2026 schedule: every road but North to Northeast Entrance closes to regular vehicles Oct 31 (Dunraven Pass, Beartooth and Chief Joseph Oct 12); the last to open, Dunraven Pass, opens May 22. The layer says Unknown on 1,979 of the park's 2,007 segments, so Unknown is read as seasonal here

except.road: North Entrance to Northeast Entrance, Yellowstone
except.basis: "generally open year-round to regular vehicles" from Gardiner to Cooke City (the same page); through Gardiner by the Temporary North Entrance Road, the only one in the graph since the 2022 flood

parks.basis: Teton Park Road closed Nov 1 - Apr 30; Moose-Wilson Road closed Nov 1 until mid-May, the longer; secondary roads close by conditions with no dates
Tioga Road and Glacier Point Road closed "usually from sometime in November through late May or early June": Nov 1 to Jun 10 at the longer ends
2026 seasons of the secondary roads; the longest closed is Heintooga Ridge Road, open 5/15-10/31. Kuwohi Road has its own row
the park highway's last ten seasons (2016-2026): earliest closing Oct 21 (2021), latest full opening Jul 26 (2017)
Rim Drive and the North Entrance Road close "on November 1, or earlier", read as two weeks earlier; East Rim Drive is "often mid-July" before it opens, and its reopening runs to late July
Old Fall River Road is open "from early July to early October"; Trail Ridge Road's segments carry their own dated description
unpaved roads open May 15 - Nov 15, the longer closure; Park Loop Road and paved roads open Apr 15 - Dec 1

parks.park: Katahdin Woods and Waters National Monument
parks.basis: "roads may be closed from mid-November to late May"; the south entrance and Loop Road "are typically open to wheeled vehicle traffic from late May-late October". Late October read as the 20th, late May as the 31st. The gates are a timber company's

The layer flags 57 km here seasonal with no description, among them Lincoln Blvd and Washington Blvd in the Presidio. No seasonal closure of these roads is published; the park's road closures are for construction, events and holidays, not winter. UNKNOWN_SEASON is a winter rule, so this park's flag closes nothing (a decision: docs/winter-closures-national.md)
